---
name: Wrong citation, figure, or lapsed program
about: An entry says something the official source no longer says
title: "fix: <entry id> — <what is wrong>"
labels: correction
---

## The entry

`id` (from `lib/engines/<engine>/v2026/`) and what it currently says.

## What the official source says

URL to the consolidated statute / CRA page / program page, the date you read it, and the
relevant words quoted.

## What should change

The field(s) and the new value(s), plus the `lastVerified` date to set.
